raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (the 2026-01-18 delivery) carries amounts formatted with a leading dollar sign (for example \"$14.09\"), while every earlier batch uses plain decimals, so the strict DECIMAL cast in silver_transactions fails. Stripping a leading \"$\" before the cast restores the intended value, and any other unexpected format still fails loudly instead of being silently converted.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(regexp_replace(trim(amount), '^[$]', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
